Button.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Button/Button.tsx: variant=primary|neutral|subtle (default primary), size=medium|small (default medium), isDisabled=false|true (default false). children is the label. Icons are children too, not props: <Button><IconArrowLeft />Label</Button>. hasIconStart / hasIconEnd show them, iconStart / iconEnd swap them. With href the same component renders a link.

ButtonDanger.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Button/Button.tsx (ButtonDanger): variant=danger-primary|danger-subtle (default danger-primary), size=medium|small (default medium), isDisabled=false|true (default false). Only for destructive actions. children, icons: as Button.

IconButton.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/IconButton/IconButton.tsx: variant=primary|neutral|subtle (default primary), size=medium|small (default medium), isDisabled=false|true (default false). children is the icon (swap it). aria-label is required and renders nothing: it lives on a hidden text layer so the name travels with the frame.

DestructiveIconButton.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/IconButton/IconButton.tsx (DestructiveIconButton): variant=danger-primary|danger-subtle (default danger-primary), size=medium|small (default medium), isDisabled=false|true (default false). children is the icon. aria-label: as IconButton.

ButtonGroup.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Button/Button.tsx (ButtonGroup): align=start|center|end|justify|stack (default start). children are Buttons: real Button instances here, so their own properties stay editable.

Tag.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Tag/Tag.tsx: scheme=brand|danger|positive|warning|neutral (default brand), variant=primary|secondary (default primary). children is the label. onRemove (a function in code) shows the remove button.

TagButton.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Tag/Tag.tsx (TagButton): scheme=brand|danger|positive|warning|neutral (default brand), variant=primary|secondary (default primary). A tag you can press; with href it renders a link.

TagToggle.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Tag/Tag.tsx (TagToggle): isSelected and isDisabled are states the surrounding TagToggleGroup decides (selectedKeys, disabledKeys), named as React Aria names them. iconStart is a prop: hasIconStart shows it, iconStart swaps it. children is the label.

InputField.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Input/Input.tsx (InputField): isDisabled, isInvalid (React Aria TextField props, default false). label, description, placeholder, errorMessage are string props; hasLabel / hasDescription show the optional parts. hasValue=false shows the placeholder, true the value (defaultValue). errorMessage only renders while isInvalid.

TextareaField.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Textarea/Textarea.tsx (TextareaField): isDisabled, isInvalid (default false). label, description, placeholder, errorMessage are string props; hasLabel / hasDescription show the optional parts. hasValue=false shows the placeholder, true the value.

SelectField.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Select/Select.tsx (SelectField), closed. isDisabled, isInvalid (default false). label, description, placeholder, errorMessage are string props. hasValue=false shows the placeholder, true the selected item's text. The open list is ListBox with SelectItem.

CheckboxField.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Checkbox/Checkbox.tsx (CheckboxField): isSelected=false|true, isIndeterminate=false|true, isDisabled=false|true (React Aria props, default false). label and description are string props; hasDescription shows the description. In code the dash only shows when isSelected and isIndeterminate are both true, so isIndeterminate alone is not drawn.

SwitchField.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Switch/Switch.tsx (SwitchField): isSelected=false|true, isDisabled=false|true (React Aria props, default false). label and description are string props; hasDescription shows the description.

RadioField.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Radio/Radio.tsx (RadioField): isDisabled is a prop; isSelected is decided by the RadioGroup around it (its value), named as React Aria names the state. label and description are string props; hasDescription shows the description.

SliderField.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Slider/Slider.tsx (SliderField): isDisabled=false|true. label, description are string props, showOutput shows the value. The thumb sits at defaultValue=50 of 0–100; resize the track fill on an instance for another value. Two values (a range) are not drawn.

Search.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Search/Search.tsx: placeholder is the hint. The button is the library's IconButton (subtle, small): IconSearch while empty, IconX once something is typed. results (the suggestion list) opens as ListBox and is not drawn here.

NavigationPill.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Navigation/Navigation.tsx (NavigationPill): isSelected=false|true (default false). children is the label. With href it renders a link, without it a button.

NavigationButton.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Navigation/Navigation.tsx (NavigationButton): direction=column|row (default column), size=medium|small (default medium), isSelected=false|true. icon is a prop: hasIcon shows it, icon swaps it. children is the label.

Navigation.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Navigation/Navigation.tsx: direction=row|column (default row). children are NavigationPill or NavigationButton: real instances here.

Avatar.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Avatar/Avatar.tsx: size=small|medium|large (default medium), square=false|true (default false). hasImage=true stands for a src; without one the initials show. AvatarButton looks the same and is pressable.

AvatarGroup.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Avatar/Avatar.tsx (AvatarGroup): spacing=100|200|300|negative-100|negative-200|negative-300 (default 200), max (default 3) is how many avatars show before the rest collapse into +n. children are Avatars: real instances here.

AvatarBlock.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Avatar/Avatar.tsx (AvatarBlock): title (required), description (optional; hasDescription shows it). children is an Avatar or AvatarButton.

Notification.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Notification/Notification.tsx: variant=message|alert (default message), isDismissible shows the dismiss button (an IconButton; DestructiveIconButton for alert), icon is a prop (hasIcon / icon). children are free content: here a TextStrong title and a Text body.

AccordionItem.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Accordion/Accordion.tsx (AccordionItem): title is a prop, children the panel content. isExpanded is React Aria's Disclosure state (defaultExpanded in code). Note: AccordionItem takes isExpanded and isDisabled out of its props and never passes them on, so in code they do nothing.

Accordion.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Accordion/Accordion.tsx: a group of AccordionItem, real instances here. allowsMultipleExpanded (React Aria DisclosureGroup) lets more than one stay open.

Tab.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Tab/Tab.tsx (Tab): isSelected and isDisabled are decided by the Tabs around it (selectedKey, disabledKeys), named as React Aria names the state. children is the label.

Tabs.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Tab/Tab.tsx (Tabs, TabList, TabPanel): the tabs are real Tab instances. To move the selection, set isSelected on the tabs; in code that is selectedKey on Tabs.

MenuItem.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Menu/Menu.tsx (MenuItem): isDisabled is decided by the Menu around it (disabledKeys). children are free: an icon, MenuLabel, MenuDescription and MenuShortcut here, each switchable.

Menu.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Menu/Menu.tsx (Menu, MenuHeader, MenuHeading, MenuSection, MenuSeparator): the list that MenuButton or MenuTrigger opens. Items are real MenuItem instances. The popover around it (position, shadow placement) only exists at runtime.

Dialog.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Dialog/Dialog.tsx (Dialog with DialogClose, DialogTitle, DialogDescription): type=card|sheet (default card). The close button and the actions are real IconButton and Button instances. The backdrop (DialogModal) is not drawn.

Tooltip.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Tooltip/Tooltip.tsx: placement=top|bottom|left|right (React Aria Popover prop). children are free content: a TextStrong and a TextSmall here. Where it sits relative to its trigger is decided at runtime.

Pagination.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Pagination/Pagination.tsx (Pagination, PaginationPrevious, PaginationList, PaginationPage, PaginationGap, PaginationNext): every control is a real Button instance — subtle, and primary for the current page. PaginationList hides below the tablet breakpoint in code.

TextPrice.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Text/Text.tsx (TextPrice): size=large|small (default large). currency, price and label are string props.

TextContentHeading.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Text/Text.tsx (TextContentHeading): align=start|center (default start). heading and subheading are string props.

TextContentTitle.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Text/Text.tsx (TextContentTitle): align=start|center (default start). title and subtitle are props. On a phone the title drops from the hero to the page style (useMediaQuery); drawn at desktop width.

Logo.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Logo/Logo.tsx: no props. The drawing is an SVG in the code, imported as it is.

Image.description: Contract — src/ui/primitives/Image/Image.tsx: variant=default|rounded (default rounded), aspectRatio=1-1|4-3|16-9|fill|natural (default natural), size=small|medium|large|fill|natural (default natural). natural and fill depend on the picture and the container, so they are not drawn. The picture is a placeholder fill: drop your own image on it.

k: Body text for whatever you would like to say.

text.heading: Title
text.body: Body text for whatever you would like to say.

Card.description: Contract — src/ui/compositions/Cards/Cards.tsx (Card): variant=default|stroke|brand (default default), direction=vertical|horizontal (default vertical), padding=600|800 (0 stands for leaving it out, the default), align=start|center|end (not drawn), asset (an icon or Image; the boolean shows it). children are free content: a TextHeading, a Text and a Button here. interactionProps makes the whole card pressable and draws nothing.

PricingCard.description: Contract — src/ui/compositions/Cards/Cards.tsx (PricingCard): variant=default|stroke|brand, size=large|small (the price). heading, price, priceCurrency, priceLabel, action and list are props. The action is a real Button instance.

p.heading: Product
p.description: A short description of the product.

text.heading: Product
text.description: A short description of the product.

ProductInfoCard.description: Contract — src/ui/compositions/Cards/Cards.tsx (ProductInfoCard): asset, heading, price, rating, description are props.

ReviewCard.description: Contract — src/ui/compositions/Cards/Cards.tsx (ReviewCard): stars (0–5), title, body, name, date, src are props. The author is a real Avatar instance inside an AvatarBlock.

StatsCard.description: Contract — src/ui/compositions/Cards/Cards.tsx (StatsCard): icon, stat, description are props.

TestimonialCard.description: Contract — src/ui/compositions/Cards/Cards.tsx (TestimonialCard): heading (the quote), name, username, src are props.

FormBox.description: Contract — src/ui/compositions/Forms/Forms.tsx (FormBox): a Form in a bordered box. Everything inside is a real instance: InputField, CheckboxField, Button.
